judgement_notes: Measurement change: scan.py now measures IPC depth against runtime/tests/ipc_reference (99 fixtures, 1116 app-reachable ids; runner compiled from runtime/tests/test_ipc_reference.c so scan and make test bind rows identically) with the standard status weights (impl 1, stub 0.5, missing 0) plus unfixtured tables row by row; the old impl/(impl+stub) row ratio (81%) penalised turning runtime_fail ids into documented defaults and could not see missing ids. Weights unchanged. scan.py also lists commits since the previous snapshot's commit (the date-only --since printed none). New honest findings: 24-bit depth readback refused (depth/stencil formats -> partial), NVN separate texture/sampler binds ignored by the replay, viewport swizzles / subroutines no-ops (stub), 7 inferred-signature r2 entry points + provoking vertex + conservative raster partial. Rule kept: verified on a title => impl (swkbd); synthetic only => impl only with trusted semantics and no refused branch (MSAA now impl; texture views and web stay partial for refused branches). Unreachable on this Mac: XFB/tess title evidence, nvjpg/msenc/nvdisp/nvhost-gpu, IR camera, NCA0/2.
